messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up from onboarding today: client ClearHarbor repeatedly asked for three things: 1) per-route cost visibility in some format, 2) the ability to pin an embedding model per route, 3) a short onboarding checklist with starter prompts. They said lack of per-route visibility is a renewal concern.

Devon (PM): Can you paste exact phrases they used and which routes matter?

Maya (CS): Quotes: 
- "We need per-route cost so we can allocate to product teams."
- "If embeddings spike, we need to pin to a cheaper model per route."
- "A checklist with sample prompts would have saved us a day."
They called out `inbox-summarize` and `search-embeddings` across 3 onboarding sessions.

Lena (Product): Thanks. My short triage: checklist + prompts = immediate low-effort win; CSV export of per-route costs = short-term stopgap; full console UI + billing rollups = longer roadmap item. Embedding-pin per-route is medium effort but high impact.

Tom (Eng): For CSV export we need route_id in the billing aggregation and a small endpoint to pull CSVs by account. Estimate: 2 dev days for CSV pipeline + auth. Embedding-pin could be metadata + override lookup, ~3 dev days. Full UI is multiple sprints. Example stopgap query: 
```sql
SELECT route_id, DATE(ts) as day, SUM(cost_cents) as cost_cents
FROM billing_events
WHERE account_id='clearharbor' AND ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY route_id, day;
```

Maya (CS): I'll collect verbatim snippets and open a cs:feedback ticket. Recommend marking the account as at-risk if we don't provide CSV by 2026-04-10. Also request an enablement one-pager for CSMs.

Devon (PM): Action items: Maya opens ticket with quotes + example routes; Product drafts checklist and prompts; Eng scopes CSV and embedding-pin endpoint. I'll flag CSV as P0 quick-win.

OpsBot: JIRA ticket CS-4905 created by Maya (CS) - "ClearHarbor onboarding: per-route cost CSV + embed-pin" - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/CS-4905

Tom (Eng): Adding CS-4905 to sprint buffer; will post PR and sample CSV here when ready.

Lena (Product): Drafting checklist now, will share for CS signoff.

Maya (CS): Thanks team, I'll update ClearHarbor with interim timeline and capture renewal risk if missed. :thumbsup:
